company_name: Institute of Science Tokyo, Ohmi Lab
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company focuses on research related to dielectric thin films for memory applications, which is relevant to semiconductor technology but does not directly supply products or services.
summary: The Institute of Science Tokyo, Ohmi Lab conducts research on novel structural devices utilizing functional dielectric thin films, particularly for low-power non-volatile memory applications. Their work aims to enhance the performance of memory technologies critical for modern information and communication systems.
capabilities: Research on high dielectric constant thin films
Development of ferroelectric thin films for memory applications
Investigation of hafnium-based materials for flash memory
